The lattice and coordinates are the source's 100 GPa Cmmm structure. The paper reports a low-pressure displacive change to C2/m below about 10.8 GPa; this card and EOS retain the fitted PPv-II lineage but must not be interpreted as proof that Cmmm persists over the entire mathematical fit interval.
